contract.definition: orderProduct: OrderProduct = OrderProduct.allInstances()->any(op: OrderProduct | op.Id = orderID)
contract.postcondition: result = true and orderProduct.OrderStatus = OrderStatus::RECEIVED and Item.allInstances()->forAll(i: Item | if orderProduct.ContainedEntries@pre->exists(e: OrderEntry | e.Item@pre = i) then i.StockNumber = i.StockNumber@pre + orderProduct.ContainedEntries@pre->sumBy(e: OrderEntry | if e.Item@pre = i then e.Quantity@pre else 0 endif) else i.StockNumber = i.StockNumber@pre endif)
